context.content: What kind of movies do you like?
Hey there! I'm in the mood for some action-packed films. Preferably something thrilling and maybe with a bit of a twist. Got any recommendations?
Going Postal (2010) might fit your taste. It's got plenty of action and an unexpected twist.
2010 huh? That sounds interesting. Can you tell me more about it? Like the plot and the actors involved?

Going Postal follows a man who works as a telemarketer but dreams of becoming a professional baseball player. When he accidentally kills his boss, he takes matters into his own hands and goes on a rampage. The film stars Ed Harris and Danny DeVito.
Sounds intense! I like the plot. Ed Harris and Danny DeVito are both great actors. This seems right up my alley. [END]
